title: Tradeweb Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: New York, October 29, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW), a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes, today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
New York, October 29, 2026 – Tradeweb Markets Inc. (Nasdaq: TW), a global leader in electronic trading across asset classes, today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**$584.5 million** quarterly revenues, an increase of **14.9%** ( **15.4%** on a constant currency basis) compared to prior year period


**$258.5 million** quarterly international revenues, an increase of **22.4%** ( **23.8%** on a constant current basis) compared to prior year period


**$3.2 trillion** average daily volume (“ADV”) for the quarter, an increase of **22.4%** compared to prior year period; quarterly ADV records in municipal bonds


**$224.9 million** net income and **$238.8 million** adjusted net income for the quarter, increases of **6.8%** and **15.6%,** respectively, from prior year period


**54.5%** adjusted EBITDA margin and **$318.9 million** adjusted EBITDA for the quarter, compared to 54.0% and $274.4 million, respectively, for prior year period


**$0.94** diluted earnings per share (“Diluted EPS”) and **$1.02** adjusted diluted earnings per share for the quarter


**$0.14** per share quarterly cash dividend declared, a **16.7%** per share increase from prior year period
